user.title: OPCOM PZU
user.description:
Connect to the Romanian day-ahead electricity market (PZU) on opcom.ro.

One sensor will be created showing the current 15-minute interval price in RON/MWh. Prices for today and tomorrow are stored as statistics so you can graph the full day curve.
